scripts.build: npm run build -w @cs2d/client && npm run build -w @cs2d/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cs2d/shared && npm run test -w @cs2d/server && npm run test -w @cs2d/client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @cs2d/shared && npm run test:coverage -w @cs2d/server && npm run test:coverage -w @cs2d/client
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/integration-round.mjs && node scripts/integration-bots.mjs && node scripts/integration-malformed.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cs2d/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cs2d/server && npm run typecheck -w @cs2d/client
